headline: A Pilot Asked For A Watch On His Wrist. Cartier Made One.
stop_reason: Attempt 3 stopped at research. The only primary source I could verify is Cartier's Santos-Dumont product page, which gives one origin fact (1904 wristwatch made so Santos-Dumont could tell time while flying). Monochrome Watches adds the Edmond Jaeger and 1911 release detail and the Patek Philippe credit, but the research validator only accepts official, primary or user-supplied sources, so those facts cannot be recorded as sourced. A STORY BEHIND needs 7 to 9 sourced beats; one verified fact is not enough. No carousel, slides or caption were built. Next step: find an official Cartier or Jaeger-LeCoultre heritage page that states the 1911 Jaeger production and the Santos-Dumont request, or choose a different story.
